complete_reading_statement: I read all ten assigned canonical files completely, including Chapter 20 introduction and 20.1–20.13, every table, code block and exercise, all sections of all three guides, and all remaining entry/reference files. Prerequisite files were read only in the complete sections named below; their whole-file hashes are not whole-file reading claims. Truncated tool output for 5.12/8.8 and T.4 was followed by full bounded rereads, retained in actual reading order.

chapter20_section_connections.20.1: History/picture persistence and the hand-written equality test isolate the input merge; ASR transcript is not an answer.
chapter20_section_connections.20.2: A separate pinned checkout/environment and config manifest open the selected base without retraining. Weights arrive later at startup/first ASR; Pages and localhost are different systems.
chapter20_section_connections.20.3: 2,127,532,032 parameters times bytes per weight explain weight storage only; Dense/LoRA/ASR roles and additional runtime memory are separate.
chapter20_section_connections.20.4: The visible two-cat training photograph supports description/count questions. DOCCI, synthetic OCR, Commons, OASST and two audio sources teach/check different tasks and retain separate licenses.
chapter20_section_connections.20.5: Reworded/cropped/translated items retain the source family. Local split isolation does not establish the upstream base never saw public material.
chapter20_section_connections.20.6: A real one-step 4-to-3 LoRA layer update exposes 14 trainable values and unchanged W, then distinguishes its SGD 0.1 toy goal from language q/v rank-8 alpha-16, LR 0.00003 training.
chapter20_section_connections.20.7: Q/A ByteTokenizer makes the assistant-boundary prediction visible: six X, two targets, first at 4. The full Qwen processor/template and target counts have different units.
chapter20_section_connections.20.8: Archived 1,039/2,077-update candidates must pass termination, retention and primary-score gates before final test. Better photographs do not offset worse two-route chat; selected base still has failures.
chapter20_section_connections.20.9: Correct objects alone do not answer action/relation. Hand-written cards and artificial rider diagrams are explicitly conceptual; visible facts and unsupported additions require semantic judgment.
chapter20_section_connections.20.10: Exact transcription and general meaning differ. CER uses reference Unicode length, normalization is declared beforehand, and empty-reference presence is a separate task.
chapter20_section_connections.20.11: Counter loses order, while splitlines retains line structure. Region OCR is different from arbitrary page layout; exercise removing newline exposes the missing structure.
chapter20_section_connections.20.12: A missing negation is one edit out of nine characters but changes intent. Reference-text chat and actual-ASR chat localize responsibility; UI correction must not silently replace evaluation ASR.
chapter20_section_connections.20.13: Fingerprints pair components, not capability. The selected base plus Whisper card gives task denominators, truncations and overlap; 178 answers are not 178 independent scenes. 22 ASR transcriptions are separate from 178 assistant answers.
